description: This file defines API route handlers using FastAPI for recipe-related operations, including searching recipes, fetching recipe details, and retrieving nutrition information via Spoonacular's API.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's class for creating API route groups, used to organize the recipe endpoints.

methods.name: search_recipes( q: str = Query(..., description="Search query"), number: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=50, description="Number of results to return"), diet: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Dietary filter, e.g., vegetarian, vegan, keto"), client: SpoonacularClient = Depends(get_spoonacular_client), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search for recipes based on a query, number, and diet filter, returning the search results from Spoonacular.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve detailed information about a specific recipe by ID, optionally including nutrition data.

methods.name: get_recipe_nutrition( recipe_id: int, client: SpoonacularClient = Depends(get_spoonacular_client), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch nutrition information for a specific recipe by ID.
